mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category, safe_stock AS safeStock, status FROM product ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category, safe_stock AS safeStock, status FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category, safe_stock AS safeStock, status FROM product WHERE category = #{category}
SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category, safe_stock AS safeStock, status FROM product WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE name = #{name} AND id != #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, price, quantity, category, safe_stock, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{category}, #{safeStock}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET quantity = quantity + #{amount} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET quantity = quantity - #{amount} WHERE id = #{id} AND quantity >= #{amount}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM product WHERE category IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, name, price, quantity, category, safe_stock AS safeStock, status FROM product WHERE (safe_stock IS NOT NULL AND quantity < safe_stock) OR (safe_stock IS NULL AND quantity < #{threshold}) ORDER BY quantity ASC
